1778-4050-5006-8170.description:

Repeat.

Repeat.

4574-6900-7435-8249--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.

This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

1829-4279-5687--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1829-4279-5687--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire, Skittering Precursor and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.

When you cast that creature or when it enters, God-Eternal Oketra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature

Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.

Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.

When The Immortal Weapons enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

3129-5086-5183-5231-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
3129-5086-5183-5231-7743.description:

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.

Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

5088-5147-5211-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
5088-5147-5211-7443-7537.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Activate two of those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two mana.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Brass's Bounty.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Brass's Bounty from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, activate your remaining Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least six mana.
Cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve both copies of Brass's Bounty, creating at least sixteen Treasure tokens.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least sixteen mana.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Brass's Bounty with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Brass's Bounty from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve both copies of Brass's Bounty, creating at least sixteen Treasure tokens.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least sixteen mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Brass's Bounty.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 19.

4657-5295-6871-7288.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three mana-producing lands.

Activate three lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}.

Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {4} and tapping it, untapping the three mana-producing lands and Thousand-Year Elixir, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thousand-Year Elixir by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.
4657-5295-6871-7288.notes: You can tap more lands for mana each loop if desired. You'll need to pay an additional {1} in step 3 for each extra land tapped this way to untap them.

When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3480-5702-7288.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1606-5776-6871.description:
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping it as it's a land due to Toph and Ygra, and another land you control.
Repeat.

250-779-1168-1479-5226.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1168-1479-5226.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

Cast Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.

1168-1651-4935-5334-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.

Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.

Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Roaming Throne, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Part the Waterveil, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Part the Waterveil, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Slick Imitator from your graveyard by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
11-3942-4084-6276.notes: If you've cast a creature spell using Karador this turn, you may move to your extra turn, and then do step 6 followed by steps 1-5.

Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of each of your planeswalkers this turn.
Activate Ral Zarek's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping The Chain Veil.
Repeat.
1124-2937-4356.notes: If you control five or more creatures, this combo will net infinite mana, and you may then activate any of Xenagos' other abilities.

1952-2232-2421-2459-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Skyfire Phoenix, adding {W}.
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.

When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.

When Skyfire Phoenix enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Rograkh to your hand from the battlefield.
When Livio enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

You control at least three Islands.
You have not cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
3234-4050-4377-5131.description:
Activate three Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Walk the Aeons with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and return Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing World Shaper, adding {G}.
World Shaper dies, triggering its second ability, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Cast World Shaper from your graveyard by paying {3}{G}.
World Shaper enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, allowing you to mill three cards.
Repeat each turn.
